services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Start your day in Newport on a narrated lighthouse cruise aboard the spacious Coastal Queen. This boat tour will take you up close to the lighthouses that surround the Newport Harbor area. Enjoy panoramic views of Rose Island Lighthouse, Castle Hill Light, Goat Island Lighthouse and more, while enjoying a mimosa, included in the price of the cruise.‍ Coastal Queen offers maximum comfort as this tour boat has a weatherproof interior that can be heated on chilly days, and an open-air covered deck where the clear side curtains can roll up for catching the ocean breezes or rolled down for warmth. This boat tour departs at 11:30am daily* from 5 Bowen’s Landing on Bowen’s Wharf, Newport, RI.

Let us know what you have in mind for your event and we can make it happen! CruiseRI offers a versatile fleet of vessels accommodating 34 to 140 passengers, with convenient docking locations in Jamestown and Newport, Rhode Island. Whether you’re planning an intimate gathering or a large celebration, our fleet is ready to float your party.Private charters are available mid-February through December 31, with vessel availability varying by date. blurb: Guests can enjoy narrated scenic cruises around Newport Harbor and Narragansett Bay, including lighthouse tours and sunset sails. The Coastal Queen offers themed event cruises, private charters for groups from 34 to 140 passengers, and packages combining cruises with helicopter tours. Cruises feature amenities like heated interiors, onboard bars, and catering options.
